records.purpose: Tasarım belgelerini taze bağlamlı yorumcu ajanlarla inceleyen Claude Code eklentisi (Google Elephant-Goldfish Model). Belgeler ajanın kendi model sağlayıcısında işlenir; bootstrap ajanı dosya yazma ve kabuk araçlarını bildirir. Bu uygulama kurmaz, çalıştırmaz.

targetEvidence.limitation: The publisher's Claude Code guide gives Windows path syntax for permission rules but no support statement for Windows or any CPU architecture. Documentation is not a functional test and nothing was tested.
The publisher's Claude Code guide names no macOS behaviour and no CPU architecture. Nothing was tested.

installMethods.publisherPin: plugin egm from the marketplace google/elephant-goldfish-model (publisher-stated; not checked against the marketplace)

dependencies: Claude Code 2.1.271 or newer for omitClaudeMd support; older versions are not treated as verified isolation environments (docs/claude.md)
privilegeClaims: Runs inside Claude Code under the session's permission rules; the user approves reads and writes (docs/claude.md)
Reviewer agents declare Read, Grep and Glob only (agent files at the pinned commit)
The bootstrap orchestrator agent declares Agent, Bash, Read, Grep, Glob, Write and Edit (same files)
The synthesizer agent declares Agent, Read, Grep, Glob and Write; the host does not restrict its Write to a path (docs/claude.md)
Bootstrap can run local discovery commands and a project-configured formatter (publisher's data-handling note)
No hooks file and no .mcp.json exist in the pinned tree (listing of 401 paths and a text search, 2026-11-08)
networkClaims: The publisher states the package operates no hosted service, database, analytics client or telemetry endpoint (docs/privacy.md)
Prompts, files and model responses are processed by the host assistant under the host's own account, terms and retention (docs/privacy.md)
A formatter or other command the user approves may contact a package registry or another service (docs/privacy.md)
The publisher's install command is 'claude plugin marketplace add google/elephant-goldfish-model'; how the host fetches the marketplace was not checked

notes: The publisher says the host assistant reads the project files and documents supplied for a task and processes them under its own account settings, terms and privacy policy (docs/privacy.md); content is therefore processed by the host assistant, not by a service of the publisher. Cost and data handling depend on the host.

The reviewer agents are read-only by declaration; the declaration was read, not tested. The bootstrap skill's orchestrator declares file-write, edit and shell tools and is run only when a user starts it. This record starts nothing and authorises nothing.
The publisher's tree also contains adapters for other hosts (for example a Codex one). They are outside this record: the catalog schema has no Codex agent surface, so no Codex row exists.
No telemetry is declared by the publisher; none was tested. The statement about hooks and .mcp.json covers the pinned commit only, not other revisions.
